info.title: RecallFabric
info.description: Persistent, structured, portable memory for AI applications.

get.summary: Get service capabilities and active models
get.description: Inspect service version, active embedding model details, supported memory categories, enabled security features, and operational limits.

post.summary: Store a memory or extract facts from conversation
post.description: Store an explicit memory statement or extract atomic facts from conversation text. Use `content` for direct storage (preferences, facts, goals, etc.) with automatic deduplication and conflict superseding. Set `extract=true` to automatically analyze conversation turns and extract isolated facts.

post.summary: Recall relevant memories for a query
post.description: Retrieve relevant user memories for a query, ranked by multi-factor relevance (semantic similarity, importance, recency, and access frequency). Returns a structured list of memories and a pre-formatted, character-budgeted `context` markdown string ready for system prompt injection.

post.summary: Delete a memory by ID or search query with confirmation
post.description: Delete a user memory either by its exact UUID (`memory_id`), or by semantically finding the best match for a `query`. When searching by query without `confirm=true`, the endpoint returns the candidate memory awaiting confirmation. Pass `confirm=true` to confirm permanent deletion.

get.summary: Get compact user profile summary and top active memories
get.description: Retrieve a compact summary of the user's active memories organized by category (preferences, profile, goals, skills, facts). Returns a pre-assembled markdown profile ready for context injection.

parameters.name: limit

schema.description: Max memories to include in summary

parameters.description: Max memories to include in summary

post.description: Registers a user and issues an active API key when public signup is enabled.

Accepts standard chat completion requests, retrieves relevant user memories, injects them into the system message, and forwards the request to upstream LLM providers. Streams responses back unchanged and optionally extracts new facts asynchronously.

post.summary: Ingest conversation transcript for asynchronous memory extraction
post.description: Accepts a full conversation transcript (list of messages) from external apps and triggers asynchronous batch fact extraction and memory consolidation. Returns a job ID and a status URL to poll for results.

content.title: Content
content.description: Direct memory statement to store. 'content' or 'text' must be provided.
examples: User prefers concise Python code snippets.

text.title: Text
text.description: Free text or conversation turn from which to extract memories when extract=true, or alias for content.
examples: I just moved to Seattle and I work as a systems engineer.

type.title: Type
type.description: Category of the memory: preference, goal, skill, profile, fact, or other

importance.title: Importance
importance.description: Importance score from 0.0 to 1.0. Defaults to 0.5 (or model-assessed when extract=true).

confidence.title: Confidence
confidence.description: Confidence score from 0.0 to 1.0 that this memory is accurate and truthful.

source.title: Source
source.description: Source identifier (e.g. system name, conversation ID, tool call).

extract.title: Extract
extract.description: When true, passes text through the LLM extraction pipeline to isolate atomic facts.

user_id.title: User Id
user_id.description: Target user identifier (optional; automatically derived from authenticated API key when auth is enabled).

metadata.title: Metadata
metadata.description: Arbitrary JSON metadata attributes to attach to the memory.

RememberRequest.title: RememberRequest
RememberRequest.description:
Store explicit memory or extract facts from free-form conversation text.

Designed for AI tool use: pass `content` for direct storage or `text` with `extract=true`
to isolate atomic facts automatically.

examples.text: I just moved to Seattle and I work as a systems engineer.

status.title: Status
status.description: Outcome category: created (new), deduplicated (existing updated), superseded (conflicting replaced), or extracted.

memories.description: List of memories stored or extracted during this operation
